notes: kohls.com is behind Akamai. Plain HTTP (requests/curl/curl_cffi TLS impersonation, WebFetch, r.jina.ai) returns 'Access Denied' (errors.edgesuite.net reference) for every page except /robots.txt and /sitemap*.xml; some TLS profiles instead get the Akamai sec-cpt JS interstitial. Extracted with a local isolated Chromium (patchright, headed, own profile in the worker scratchpad - NOT the shared Chrome MCP browser). Category tree taken from the site's own facet data: the 'Filters' astro-island props on each /catalog/*.jsp page expose dimensions[Category|Product|Silhouette].dimensionValues with a productCount per sub-category URL. Every qty below was then re-verified by fetching that sub-category URL itself and reading its own BrowseHeading props.productCount, which matched the visible 'Show N Items' header on all 89 pages. Department totals for reference (site-reported): Home Decor 107,082; Kitchen & Dining 61,098. Rows come from Kohl's 'Product' sub-category level, plus a few 'Silhouette' leaf pages for lighting, picture frames and glassware types named in the spec - those are finer slices of their Product parent, so Lighting/Frames/Glassware rows overlap by design rather than summing. Excluded per spec: rugs, window treatments, decorative pillows, slipcovers, table/kitchen linens, cookware, flatware, small appliances, kitchen storage, all clocks, wall hooks, display ledges/cases, ceiling fans, water bottles, flags, tree skirts/stands, stockings, picnic baskets, growth charts.
